entities.summary: Benin is a sovereign nation in West Africa, Africa. Its capital is Porto-Novo (official), Cotonou (seat of government). Official languages include French. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 13.7 million. Area: 114,763 km².
